gloss: to order; to send away for; to have something delivered

definitions.gloss: to order; to send away for; to have something delivered
definitions.explanation: to request that something be sent from a distant location, often specialty food or goods not available locally

examples.japanese: {北海道|ほっかいどう}からカニを{取|と}り{寄|よ}せた。
ネットでお{取|と}り{寄|よ}せスイーツを{注文|ちゅうもん}した。
examples.english: I ordered specialty sweets for delivery online.

examples.japanese: {地方|ちほう}の{名産品|めいさんひん}を{取|と}り{寄|よ}せて、{家族|かぞく}で{楽|たの}しむのが{趣味|しゅみ}です。
examples.english: My hobby is ordering regional specialties and enjoying them with my family.

notes:
Specifically implies ordering from a distant or special source rather than buying at a local store. Very commonly used for regional specialty foods (お{取|と}り{寄|よ}せグルメ). The honorific prefix お is frequently attached in commercial contexts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- お{取|と}り{寄|よ}せグルメ: mail-order gourmet food
- {産地|さんち}から{取|と}り{寄|よ}せる: order directly from the production area
- ネットで{取|と}り{寄|よ}せる: order online for delivery
- {取|と}り{寄|よ}せ{品|ひん}: items ordered from elsewhere

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {注文|ちゅうもん}する: to order — general ordering, including at restaurants; {取|と}り{寄|よ}せる specifically implies ordering from a distant source
- {通販|つうはん}で{買|か}う: to buy via mail order — more neutral; {取|と}り{寄|よ}せる carries a nuance of specialty or luxury

CULTURAL NOTE:
お{取|と}り{寄|よ}せ culture is very popular in Japan, where people order famous local specialties ({名物|めいぶつ}) from other regions. Department store catalogs and online services specialize in this.
